title: Red quartzite conduit and collection bowl at Abusir

tellings.quote: Below the eastern temple, there is a red quartzite conduit system. This red quartzite conduit goes underneath the black paving, black basalt paving of the eastern temple and it deposits into a red quartzite collection bowl.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, who argues that the Egyptian pyramids had a purpose other than being tombs, tells podcast host Jesse Michels what he says he saw in 2017 at the pyramid of the pharaoh Niuserre at Abusir in Egypt. He says that below the eastern temple there is a system of channels made of red quartzite, a hard stone, running under the black basalt floor and emptying into a red quartzite collection bowl, a point he credits to a man named Yousef Awyan. Drumm tells it because, in his view, it shows the site was built to move some kind of fluid, which would change how the pyramids are understood.
